name: Microsoft Outlook
description: Bounded typed Microsoft Graph mail, drafts, folders, attachments, categories and calendars with explicit mutation confirmations.

permissions.description: Microsoft Graph HTTPS only; externally supplied OAuth access token through a connection or named secret; explicit mutation guards and no retry. definitions.name: Get Outlook Profile (Direct)
definitions.description: Get Outlook Profile
definitions.documentation:
Get Outlook Profile: GET /v1.0/{me|users/userId}. One fixed-origin Graph HTTPS request, zero retries and redirect:error. Optional userId defaults to me; application tokens require an explicit userId. RuntimeConnection.config plus credentials.accessToken via config.$connection; tokenSecret selects an external secret. External OAuth issuance/refresh/consent and least privilege scopes required. No OAuth acquisition or renewal. Total 10 s default/30 s maximum deadline starts before profile/secret lookup, bounded 100 ms cleanup; 512 KiB request/1 MiB response/256 KiB attachment bytes, pages 1–100. Exact dot and percent identities are rejected before credentials; all other route fragments are percent encoded. Strict UTF-16 input and fatal UTF-8 response JSON. Known fields projected, optional absence/null/falsy values preserved. Returned @odata.nextLink and @odata.deltaLink are opaque output only; no follow-link input or automatic pagination. ImmutableId preference enabled. No MIME, large upload session, nested item attachment expansion, webhook listener, delta continuation replay, or national-cloud endpoint. Event mutations can notify attendees and message sends are not delivery confirmation. definitions.description: List Outlook Messages
definitions.documentation:
List Outlook Messages: GET /v1.0/{me|users/userId}/messages. One fixed-origin Graph HTTPS request, zero retries and redirect:error. Optional userId defaults to me; application tokens require an explicit userId. RuntimeConnection.config plus credentials.accessToken via config.$connection; tokenSecret selects an external secret. External OAuth issuance/refresh/consent and least privilege scopes required. No OAuth acquisition or renewal. Total 10 s default/30 s maximum deadline starts before profile/secret lookup, bounded 100 ms cleanup; 512 KiB request/1 MiB response/256 KiB attachment bytes, pages 1–100. Exact dot and percent identities are rejected before credentials; all other route fragments are percent encoded. Strict UTF-16 input and fatal UTF-8 response JSON. Known fields projected, optional absence/null/falsy values preserved. Returned @odata.nextLink and @odata.deltaLink are opaque output only; no follow-link input or automatic pagination. ImmutableId preference enabled. No MIME, large upload session, nested item attachment expansion, webhook listener, delta continuation replay, or national-cloud endpoint. Event mutations can notify attendees and message sends are not delivery confirmation. definitions.description: Get Outlook Message
definitions.documentation:
Get Outlook Message: GET /v1.0/{me|users/userId}/messages/{messageId}. One fixed-origin Graph HTTPS request, zero retries and redirect:error. Optional userId defaults to me; application tokens require an explicit userId. RuntimeConnection.config plus credentials.accessToken via config.$connection; tokenSecret selects an external secret. External OAuth issuance/refresh/consent and least privilege scopes required. No OAuth acquisition or renewal. Total 10 s default/30 s maximum deadline starts before profile/secret lookup, bounded 100 ms cleanup; 512 KiB request/1 MiB response/256 KiB attachment bytes, pages 1–100. Exact dot and percent identities are rejected before credentials; all other route fragments are percent encoded. Strict UTF-16 input and fatal UTF-8 response JSON. Known fields projected, optional absence/null/falsy values preserved. Returned @odata.nextLink and @odata.deltaLink are opaque output only; no follow-link input or automatic pagination. ImmutableId preference enabled. No MIME, large upload session, nested item attachment expansion, webhook listener, delta continuation replay, or national-cloud endpoint. Event mutations can notify attendees and message sends are not delivery confirmation. definitions.description: List Outlook Folder Messages
definitions.documentation:
List Outlook Folder Messages: GET /v1.0/{me|users/userId}/mailFolders/{folderId}/messages. One fixed-origin Graph HTTPS request, zero retries and redirect:error. Optional userId defaults to me; application tokens require an explicit userId. RuntimeConnection.config plus credentials.accessToken via config.$connection; tokenSecret selects an external secret. External OAuth issuance/refresh/consent and least privilege scopes required. No OAuth acquisition or renewal. Total 10 s default/30 s maximum deadline starts before profile/secret lookup, bounded 100 ms cleanup; 512 KiB request/1 MiB response/256 KiB attachment bytes, pages 1–100. Exact dot and percent identities are rejected before credentials; all other route fragments are percent encoded. Strict UTF-16 input and fatal UTF-8 response JSON. Known fields projected, optional absence/null/falsy values preserved. Returned @odata.nextLink and @odata.deltaLink are opaque output only; no follow-link input or automatic pagination. ImmutableId preference enabled. No MIME, large upload session, nested item attachment expansion, webhook listener, delta continuation replay, or national-cloud endpoint. Event mutations can notify attendees and message sends are not delivery confirmation. definitions.documentation:
Create Outlook Draft: POST /v1.0/{me|users/userId}/messages. Requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation DRAFTS_CREATE. Reconcile uncertain outcomes before repeating. One fixed-origin Graph HTTPS request, zero retries and redirect:error. Optional userId defaults to me; application tokens require an explicit userId. RuntimeConnection.config plus credentials.accessToken via config.$connection; tokenSecret selects an external secret. External OAuth issuance/refresh/consent and least privilege scopes required. No OAuth acquisition or renewal. Total 10 s default/30 s maximum deadline starts before profile/secret lookup, bounded 100 ms cleanup; 512 KiB request/1 MiB response/256 KiB attachment bytes, pages 1–100. Exact dot and percent identities are rejected before credentials; all other route fragments are percent encoded. Strict UTF-16 input and fatal UTF-8 response JSON. Known fields projected, optional absence/null/falsy values preserved. Returned @odata.nextLink and @odata.deltaLink are opaque output only; no follow-link input or automatic pagination. ImmutableId preference enabled. No MIME, large upload session, nested item attachment expansion, webhook listener, delta continuation replay, or national-cloud endpoint. Event mutations can notify attendees and message sends are not delivery confirmation. definitions.documentation:
Update Outlook Message: PATCH /v1.0/{me|users/userId}/messages/{messageId}. Requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation MESSAGES_UPDATE. Reconcile uncertain outcomes before repeating. One fixed-origin Graph HTTPS request, zero retries and redirect:error. Optional userId defaults to me; application tokens require an explicit userId. RuntimeConnection.config plus credentials.accessToken via config.$connection; tokenSecret selects an external secret. External OAuth issuance/refresh/consent and least privilege scopes required. No OAuth acquisition or renewal. Total 10 s default/30 s maximum deadline starts before profile/secret lookup, bounded 100 ms cleanup; 512 KiB request/1 MiB response/256 KiB attachment bytes, pages 1–100. Exact dot and percent identities are rejected before credentials; all other route fragments are percent encoded. Strict UTF-16 input and fatal UTF-8 response JSON. Known fields projected, optional absence/null/falsy values preserved. Returned @odata.nextLink and @odata.deltaLink are opaque output only; no follow-link input or automatic pagination. ImmutableId preference enabled. No MIME, large upload session, nested item attachment expansion, webhook listener, delta continuation replay, or national-cloud endpoint. Event mutations can notify attendees and message sends are not delivery confirmation. definitions.documentation:
Delete Outlook Message: DELETE /v1.0/{me|users/userId}/messages/{messageId}. Requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation MESSAGES_DELETE. Reconcile uncertain outcomes before repeating. One fixed-origin Graph HTTPS request, zero retries and redirect:error. Optional userId defaults to me; application tokens require an explicit userId. RuntimeConnection.config plus credentials.accessToken via config.$connection; tokenSecret selects an external secret. External OAuth issuance/refresh/consent and least privilege scopes required. No OAuth acquisition or renewal. Total 10 s default/30 s maximum deadline starts before profile/secret lookup, bounded 100 ms cleanup; 512 KiB request/1 MiB response/256 KiB attachment bytes, pages 1–100. Exact dot and percent identities are rejected before credentials; all other route fragments are percent encoded. Strict UTF-16 input and fatal UTF-8 response JSON. Known fields projected, optional absence/null/falsy values preserved. Returned @odata.nextLink and @odata.deltaLink are opaque output only; no follow-link input or automatic pagination. ImmutableId preference enabled. No MIME, large upload session, nested item attachment expansion, webhook listener, delta continuation replay, or national-cloud endpoint. Event mutations can notify attendees and message sends are not delivery confirmation. definitions.name: Send Outlook Draft (Direct)
definitions.description: Send Outlook Draft
definitions.documentation:
Send Outlook Draft: POST /v1.0/{me|users/userId}/messages/{messageId}/send. Requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation DRAFTS_SEND. Reconcile uncertain outcomes before repeating. One fixed-origin Graph HTTPS request, zero retries and redirect:error. Optional userId defaults to me; application tokens require an explicit userId. RuntimeConnection.config plus credentials.accessToken via config.$connection; tokenSecret selects an external secret. External OAuth issuance/refresh/consent and least privilege scopes required. No OAuth acquisition or renewal. Total 10 s default/30 s maximum deadline starts before profile/secret lookup, bounded 100 ms cleanup; 512 KiB request/1 MiB response/256 KiB attachment bytes, pages 1–100. Exact dot and percent identities are rejected before credentials; all other route fragments are percent encoded. Strict UTF-16 input and fatal UTF-8 response JSON. Known fields projected, optional absence/null/falsy values preserved. Returned @odata.nextLink and @odata.deltaLink are opaque output only; no follow-link input or automatic pagination. ImmutableId preference enabled. No MIME, large upload session, nested item attachment expansion, webhook listener, delta continuation replay, or national-cloud endpoint. Event mutations can notify attendees and message sends are not delivery confirmation. definitions.name: Send Outlook Mail (Direct)
definitions.description: Send Outlook Mail
definitions.documentation:
Send Outlook Mail: POST /v1.0/{me|users/userId}/sendMail. Requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation MAIL_SEND. Reconcile uncertain outcomes before repeating. One fixed-origin Graph HTTPS request, zero retries and redirect:error. Optional userId defaults to me; application tokens require an explicit userId. RuntimeConnection.config plus credentials.accessToken via config.$connection; tokenSecret selects an external secret. External OAuth issuance/refresh/consent and least privilege scopes required. No OAuth acquisition or renewal. Total 10 s default/30 s maximum deadline starts before profile/secret lookup, bounded 100 ms cleanup; 512 KiB request/1 MiB response/256 KiB attachment bytes, pages 1–100. Exact dot and percent identities are rejected before credentials; all other route fragments are percent encoded. Strict UTF-16 input and fatal UTF-8 response JSON. Known fields projected, optional absence/null/falsy values preserved. Returned @odata.nextLink and @odata.deltaLink are opaque output only; no follow-link input or automatic pagination. ImmutableId preference enabled. No MIME, large upload session, nested item attachment expansion, webhook listener, delta continuation replay, or national-cloud endpoint. Event mutations can notify attendees and message sends are not delivery confirmation. definitions.description: Move Outlook Message
definitions.documentation:
Move Outlook Message: POST /v1.0/{me|users/userId}/messages/{messageId}/move. Requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation MESSAGES_MOVE. Reconcile uncertain outcomes before repeating. One fixed-origin Graph HTTPS request, zero retries and redirect:error. Optional userId defaults to me; application tokens require an explicit userId. RuntimeConnection.config plus credentials.accessToken via config.$connection; tokenSecret selects an external secret. External OAuth issuance/refresh/consent and least privilege scopes required. No OAuth acquisition or renewal. Total 10 s default/30 s maximum deadline starts before profile/secret lookup, bounded 100 ms cleanup; 512 KiB request/1 MiB response/256 KiB attachment bytes, pages 1–100. Exact dot and percent identities are rejected before credentials; all other route fragments are percent encoded. Strict UTF-16 input and fatal UTF-8 response JSON. Known fields projected, optional absence/null/falsy values preserved. Returned @odata.nextLink and @odata.deltaLink are opaque output only; no follow-link input or automatic pagination. ImmutableId preference enabled. No MIME, large upload session, nested item attachment expansion, webhook listener, delta continuation replay, or national-cloud endpoint. Event mutations can notify attendees and message sends are not delivery confirmation. definitions.documentation:
Copy Outlook Message: POST /v1.0/{me|users/userId}/messages/{messageId}/copy. Requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation MESSAGES_COPY. Reconcile uncertain outcomes before repeating. One fixed-origin Graph HTTPS request, zero retries and redirect:error. Optional userId defaults to me; application tokens require an explicit userId. RuntimeConnection.config plus credentials.accessToken via config.$connection; tokenSecret selects an external secret. External OAuth issuance/refresh/consent and least privilege scopes required. definitions.documentation:
Create Outlook Reply Draft: POST /v1.0/{me|users/userId}/messages/{messageId}/createReply. Requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation DRAFTS_CREATE_REPLY. Reconcile uncertain outcomes before repeating. One fixed-origin Graph HTTPS request, zero retries and redirect:error. Optional userId defaults to me; application tokens require an explicit userId. RuntimeConnection.config plus credentials.accessToken via config.$connection; tokenSecret selects an external secret. External OAuth issuance/refresh/consent and least privilege scopes required. No OAuth acquisition or renewal. Total 10 s default/30 s maximum deadline starts before profile/secret lookup, bounded 100 ms cleanup; 512 KiB request/1 MiB response/256 KiB attachment bytes, pages 1–100. Exact dot and percent identities are rejected before credentials; all other route fragments are percent encoded. Strict UTF-16 input and fatal UTF-8 response JSON. Known fields projected, optional absence/null/falsy values preserved. Returned @odata.nextLink and @odata.deltaLink are opaque output only; no follow-link input or automatic pagination. ImmutableId preference enabled. No MIME, large upload session, nested item attachment expansion, webhook listener, delta continuation replay, or national-cloud endpoint. Event mutations can notify attendees and message sends are not delivery confirmation. Create Outlook ReplyAll Draft: POST /v1.0/{me|users/userId}/messages/{messageId}/createReplyAll. Requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation DRAFTS_CREATE_REPLY_ALL. Reconcile uncertain outcomes before repeating. One fixed-origin Graph HTTPS request, zero retries and redirect:error. Optional userId defaults to me; application tokens require an explicit userId. RuntimeConnection.config plus credentials.accessToken via config.$connection; tokenSecret selects an external secret. External OAuth issuance/refresh/consent and least privilege scopes required. No OAuth acquisition or renewal. Total 10 s default/30 s maximum deadline starts before profile/secret lookup, bounded 100 ms cleanup; 512 KiB request/1 MiB response/256 KiB attachment bytes, pages 1–100. Exact dot and percent identities are rejected before credentials; all other route fragments are percent encoded. Strict UTF-16 input and fatal UTF-8 response JSON. Known fields projected, optional absence/null/falsy values preserved. Returned @odata.nextLink and @odata.deltaLink are opaque output only; no follow-link input or automatic pagination. ImmutableId preference enabled. No MIME, large upload session, nested item attachment expansion, webhook listener, delta continuation replay, or national-cloud endpoint. Event mutations can notify attendees and message sends are not delivery confirmation. definitions.documentation:
Create Outlook Forward Draft: POST /v1.0/{me|users/userId}/messages/{messageId}/createForward. Requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation DRAFTS_CREATE_FORWARD. Reconcile uncertain outcomes before repeating. One fixed-origin Graph HTTPS request, zero retries and redirect:error. Optional userId defaults to me; application tokens require an explicit userId. RuntimeConnection.config plus credentials.accessToken via config.$connection; tokenSecret selects an external secret. External OAuth issuance/refresh/consent and least privilege scopes required. No OAuth acquisition or renewal. Total 10 s default/30 s maximum deadline starts before profile/secret lookup, bounded 100 ms cleanup; 512 KiB request/1 MiB response/256 KiB attachment bytes, pages 1–100. Exact dot and percent identities are rejected before credentials; all other route fragments are percent encoded. Strict UTF-16 input and fatal UTF-8 response JSON. Known fields projected, optional absence/null/falsy values preserved. Returned @odata.nextLink and @odata.deltaLink are opaque output only; no follow-link input or automatic pagination. ImmutableId preference enabled. No MIME, large upload session, nested item attachment expansion, webhook listener, delta continuation replay, or national-cloud endpoint. Event mutations can notify attendees and message sends are not delivery confirmation. definitions.documentation:
List Outlook Attachments: GET /v1.0/{me|users/userId}/messages/{messageId}/attachments. One fixed-origin Graph HTTPS request, zero retries and redirect:error. Optional userId defaults to me; application tokens require an explicit userId. RuntimeConnection.config plus credentials.accessToken via config.$connection; tokenSecret selects an external secret. External OAuth issuance/refresh/consent and least privilege scopes required. No OAuth acquisition or renewal. Total 10 s default/30 s maximum deadline starts before profile/secret lookup, bounded 100 ms cleanup; 512 KiB request/1 MiB response/256 KiB attachment bytes, pages 1–100. Exact dot and percent identities are rejected before credentials; all other route fragments are percent encoded. Strict UTF-16 input and fatal UTF-8 response JSON. Known fields projected, optional absence/null/falsy values preserved. Returned @odata.nextLink and @odata.deltaLink are opaque output only; no follow-link input or automatic pagination. ImmutableId preference enabled. No MIME, large upload session, nested item attachment expansion, webhook listener, delta continuation replay, or national-cloud endpoint. Event mutations can notify attendees and message sends are not delivery confirmation. definitions.description: Get Outlook Attachment
definitions.documentation:
Get Outlook Attachment: GET /v1.0/{me|users/userId}/messages/{messageId}/attachments/{attachmentId}. One fixed-origin Graph HTTPS request, zero retries and redirect:error. Optional userId defaults to me; application tokens require an explicit userId. RuntimeConnection.config plus credentials.accessToken via config.$connection; tokenSecret selects an external secret. External OAuth issuance/refresh/consent and least privilege scopes required. No OAuth acquisition or renewal. Total 10 s default/30 s maximum deadline starts before profile/secret lookup, bounded 100 ms cleanup; 512 KiB request/1 MiB response/256 KiB attachment bytes, pages 1–100. Exact dot and percent identities are rejected before credentials; all other route fragments are percent encoded. Strict UTF-16 input and fatal UTF-8 response JSON. Known fields projected, optional absence/null/falsy values preserved. Returned @odata.nextLink and @odata.deltaLink are opaque output only; no follow-link input or automatic pagination. ImmutableId preference enabled. No MIME, large upload session, nested item attachment expansion, webhook listener, delta continuation replay, or national-cloud endpoint. Event mutations can notify attendees and message sends are not delivery confirmation. definitions.description: Attach Outlook File
definitions.documentation:
Attach Outlook File: POST /v1.0/{me|users/userId}/messages/{messageId}/attachments. Requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation ATTACHMENTS_CREATE. Reconcile uncertain outcomes before repeating. One fixed-origin Graph HTTPS request, zero retries and redirect:error. Optional userId defaults to me; application tokens require an explicit userId. RuntimeConnection.config plus credentials.accessToken via config.$connection; tokenSecret selects an external secret. External OAuth issuance/refresh/consent and least privilege scopes required. No OAuth acquisition or renewal. Total 10 s default/30 s maximum deadline starts before profile/secret lookup, bounded 100 ms cleanup; 512 KiB request/1 MiB response/256 KiB attachment bytes, pages 1–100. Exact dot and percent identities are rejected before credentials; all other route fragments are percent encoded. Strict UTF-16 input and fatal UTF-8 response JSON. Known fields projected, optional absence/null/falsy values preserved. Returned @odata.nextLink and @odata.deltaLink are opaque output only; no follow-link input or automatic pagination. ImmutableId preference enabled. No MIME, large upload session, nested item attachment expansion, webhook listener, delta continuation replay, or national-cloud endpoint. Event mutations can notify attendees and message sends are not delivery confirmation. definitions.documentation:
Delete Outlook Attachment: DELETE /v1.0/{me|users/userId}/messages/{messageId}/attachments/{attachmentId}. Requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation ATTACHMENTS_DELETE. Reconcile uncertain outcomes before repeating. One fixed-origin Graph HTTPS request, zero retries and redirect:error. Optional userId defaults to me; application tokens require an explicit userId. RuntimeConnection.config plus credentials.accessToken via config.$connection; tokenSecret selects an external secret. External OAuth issuance/refresh/consent and least privilege scopes required. No OAuth acquisition or renewal. Total 10 s default/30 s maximum deadline starts before profile/secret lookup, bounded 100 ms cleanup; 512 KiB request/1 MiB response/256 KiB attachment bytes, pages 1–100. Exact dot and percent identities are rejected before credentials; all other route fragments are percent encoded. Strict UTF-16 input and fatal UTF-8 response JSON. Known fields projected, optional absence/null/falsy values preserved. Returned @odata.nextLink and @odata.deltaLink are opaque output only; no follow-link input or automatic pagination. ImmutableId preference enabled. No MIME, large upload session, nested item attachment expansion, webhook listener, delta continuation replay, or national-cloud endpoint. Event mutations can notify attendees and message sends are not delivery confirmation. definitions.description: List Outlook Mail Folders
definitions.documentation:
List Outlook Mail Folders: GET /v1.0/{me|users/userId}/mailFolders. One fixed-origin Graph HTTPS request, zero retries and redirect:error. Optional userId defaults to me; application tokens require an explicit userId. RuntimeConnection.config plus credentials.accessToken via config.$connection; tokenSecret selects an external secret. External OAuth issuance/refresh/consent and least privilege scopes required. No OAuth acquisition or renewal. Total 10 s default/30 s maximum deadline starts before profile/secret lookup, bounded 100 ms cleanup; 512 KiB request/1 MiB response/256 KiB attachment bytes, pages 1–100. Exact dot and percent identities are rejected before credentials; all other route fragments are percent encoded. Strict UTF-16 input and fatal UTF-8 response JSON. Known fields projected, optional absence/null/falsy values preserved. Returned @odata.nextLink and @odata.deltaLink are opaque output only; no follow-link input or automatic pagination. ImmutableId preference enabled. No MIME, large upload session, nested item attachment expansion, webhook listener, delta continuation replay, or national-cloud endpoint. Event mutations can notify attendees and message sends are not delivery confirmation. definitions.documentation:
Get Outlook Mail Folder: GET /v1.0/{me|users/userId}/mailFolders/{folderId}. One fixed-origin Graph HTTPS request, zero retries and redirect:error. Optional userId defaults to me; application tokens require an explicit userId. RuntimeConnection.config plus credentials.accessToken via config.$connection; tokenSecret selects an external secret. External OAuth issuance/refresh/consent and least privilege scopes required. No OAuth acquisition or renewal. Total 10 s default/30 s maximum deadline starts before profile/secret lookup, bounded 100 ms cleanup; 512 KiB request/1 MiB response/256 KiB attachment bytes, pages 1–100. Exact dot and percent identities are rejected before credentials; all other route fragments are percent encoded. Strict UTF-16 input and fatal UTF-8 response JSON. Known fields projected, optional absence/null/falsy values preserved. Returned @odata.nextLink and @odata.deltaLink are opaque output only; no follow-link input or automatic pagination. ImmutableId preference enabled. No MIME, large upload session, nested item attachment expansion, webhook listener, delta continuation replay, or national-cloud endpoint. Event mutations can notify attendees and message sends are not delivery confirmation. definitions.documentation:
List Outlook Child Folders: GET /v1.0/{me|users/userId}/mailFolders/{folderId}/childFolders. One fixed-origin Graph HTTPS request, zero retries and redirect:error. Optional userId defaults to me; application tokens require an explicit userId. RuntimeConnection.config plus credentials.accessToken via config.$connection; tokenSecret selects an external secret. External OAuth issuance/refresh/consent and least privilege scopes required. No OAuth acquisition or renewal. Total 10 s default/30 s maximum deadline starts before profile/secret lookup, bounded 100 ms cleanup; 512 KiB request/1 MiB response/256 KiB attachment bytes, pages 1–100. Exact dot and percent identities are rejected before credentials; all other route fragments are percent encoded. Strict UTF-16 input and fatal UTF-8 response JSON. Known fields projected, optional absence/null/falsy values preserved. Returned @odata.nextLink and @odata.deltaLink are opaque output only; no follow-link input or automatic pagination. ImmutableId preference enabled. No MIME, large upload session, nested item attachment expansion, webhook listener, delta continuation replay, or national-cloud endpoint. Event mutations can notify attendees and message sends are not delivery confirmation. definitions.documentation:
Create Outlook Mail Folder: POST /v1.0/{me|users/userId}/mailFolders. Requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation FOLDERS_CREATE. Reconcile uncertain outcomes before repeating. One fixed-origin Graph HTTPS request, zero retries and redirect:error. Optional userId defaults to me; application tokens require an explicit userId. RuntimeConnection.config plus credentials.accessToken via config.$connection; tokenSecret selects an external secret. External OAuth issuance/refresh/consent and least privilege scopes required. No OAuth acquisition or renewal. Total 10 s default/30 s maximum deadline starts before profile/secret lookup, bounded 100 ms cleanup; 512 KiB request/1 MiB response/256 KiB attachment bytes, pages 1–100. Exact dot and percent identities are rejected before credentials; all other route fragments are percent encoded. Strict UTF-16 input and fatal UTF-8 response JSON. Known fields projected, optional absence/null/falsy values preserved. Returned @odata.nextLink and @odata.deltaLink are opaque output only; no follow-link input or automatic pagination. ImmutableId preference enabled. No MIME, large upload session, nested item attachment expansion, webhook listener, delta continuation replay, or national-cloud endpoint. Event mutations can notify attendees and message sends are not delivery confirmation. definitions.documentation:
Create Outlook Child Folder: POST /v1.0/{me|users/userId}/mailFolders/{folderId}/childFolders. Requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation FOLDER_CHILDREN_CREATE. Reconcile uncertain outcomes before repeating. One fixed-origin Graph HTTPS request, zero retries and redirect:error. Optional userId defaults to me; application tokens require an explicit userId. RuntimeConnection.config plus credentials.accessToken via config.$connection; tokenSecret selects an external secret. External OAuth issuance/refresh/consent and least privilege scopes required. No OAuth acquisition or renewal. Total 10 s default/30 s maximum deadline starts before profile/secret lookup, bounded 100 ms cleanup; 512 KiB request/1 MiB response/256 KiB attachment bytes, pages 1–100. Exact dot and percent identities are rejected before credentials; all other route fragments are percent encoded. Strict UTF-16 input and fatal UTF-8 response JSON. Known fields projected, optional absence/null/falsy values preserved. Returned @odata.nextLink and @odata.deltaLink are opaque output only; no follow-link input or automatic pagination. ImmutableId preference enabled. No MIME, large upload session, nested item attachment expansion, webhook listener, delta continuation replay, or national-cloud endpoint. Event mutations can notify attendees and message sends are not delivery confirmation. definitions.documentation:
Rename Outlook Mail Folder: PATCH /v1.0/{me|users/userId}/mailFolders/{folderId}. Requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation FOLDERS_UPDATE. Reconcile uncertain outcomes before repeating. One fixed-origin Graph HTTPS request, zero retries and redirect:error. Optional userId defaults to me; application tokens require an explicit userId. RuntimeConnection.config plus credentials.accessToken via config.$connection; tokenSecret selects an external secret. External OAuth issuance/refresh/consent and least privilege scopes required. No OAuth acquisition or renewal. Total 10 s default/30 s maximum deadline starts before profile/secret lookup, bounded 100 ms cleanup; 512 KiB request/1 MiB response/256 KiB attachment bytes, pages 1–100. Exact dot and percent identities are rejected before credentials; all other route fragments are percent encoded. Strict UTF-16 input and fatal UTF-8 response JSON. Known fields projected, optional absence/null/falsy values preserved. Returned @odata.nextLink and @odata.deltaLink are opaque output only; no follow-link input or automatic pagination. ImmutableId preference enabled. No MIME, large upload session, nested item attachment expansion, webhook listener, delta continuation replay, or national-cloud endpoint. Event mutations can notify attendees and message sends are not delivery confirmation. definitions.description: Delete Outlook Mail Folder
definitions.documentation:
Delete Outlook Mail Folder: DELETE /v1.0/{me|users/userId}/mailFolders/{folderId}. Requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation FOLDERS_DELETE. Reconcile uncertain outcomes before repeating. One fixed-origin Graph HTTPS request, zero retries and redirect:error. Optional userId defaults to me; application tokens require an explicit userId. RuntimeConnection.config plus credentials.accessToken via config.$connection; tokenSecret selects an external secret. External OAuth issuance/refresh/consent and least privilege scopes required. No OAuth acquisition or renewal. Total 10 s default/30 s maximum deadline starts before profile/secret lookup, bounded 100 ms cleanup; 512 KiB request/1 MiB response/256 KiB attachment bytes, pages 1–100. Exact dot and percent identities are rejected before credentials; all other route fragments are percent encoded. Strict UTF-16 input and fatal UTF-8 response JSON. Known fields projected, optional absence/null/falsy values preserved. Returned @odata.nextLink and @odata.deltaLink are opaque output only; no follow-link input or automatic pagination. ImmutableId preference enabled. No MIME, large upload session, nested item attachment expansion, webhook listener, delta continuation replay, or national-cloud endpoint. Event mutations can notify attendees and message sends are not delivery confirmation. definitions.documentation:
List Outlook Master Categories: GET /v1.0/{me|users/userId}/outlook/masterCategories. One fixed-origin Graph HTTPS request, zero retries and redirect:error. Optional userId defaults to me; application tokens require an explicit userId. RuntimeConnection.config plus credentials.accessToken via config.$connection; tokenSecret selects an external secret. External OAuth issuance/refresh/consent and least privilege scopes required. No OAuth acquisition or renewal. Total 10 s default/30 s maximum deadline starts before profile/secret lookup, bounded 100 ms cleanup; 512 KiB request/1 MiB response/256 KiB attachment bytes, pages 1–100. Exact dot and percent identities are rejected before credentials; all other route fragments are percent encoded. Strict UTF-16 input and fatal UTF-8 response JSON. Known fields projected, optional absence/null/falsy values preserved. Returned @odata.nextLink and @odata.deltaLink are opaque output only; no follow-link input or automatic pagination. ImmutableId preference enabled. No MIME, large upload session, nested item attachment expansion, webhook listener, delta continuation replay, or national-cloud endpoint. Event mutations can notify attendees and message sends are not delivery confirmation. Create Outlook Master Category: POST /v1.0/{me|users/userId}/outlook/masterCategories. Requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation CATEGORIES_CREATE. Reconcile uncertain outcomes before repeating. One fixed-origin Graph HTTPS request, zero retries and redirect:error. Optional userId defaults to me; application tokens require an explicit userId. RuntimeConnection.config plus credentials.accessToken via config.$connection; tokenSecret selects an external secret. External OAuth issuance/refresh/consent and least privilege scopes required. No OAuth acquisition or renewal. Total 10 s default/30 s maximum deadline starts before profile/secret lookup, bounded 100 ms cleanup; 512 KiB request/1 MiB response/256 KiB attachment bytes, pages 1–100. Exact dot and percent identities are rejected before credentials; all other route fragments are percent encoded. Strict UTF-16 input and fatal UTF-8 response JSON. Known fields projected, optional absence/null/falsy values preserved. Returned @odata.nextLink and @odata.deltaLink are opaque output only; no follow-link input or automatic pagination. ImmutableId preference enabled. No MIME, large upload session, nested item attachment expansion, webhook listener, delta continuation replay, or national-cloud endpoint. Event mutations can notify attendees and message sends are not delivery confirmation. Reconcile uncertain outcomes before repeating. One fixed-origin Graph HTTPS request, zero retries and redirect:error. Optional userId defaults to me; application tokens require an explicit userId. No OAuth acquisition or renewal. Known fields projected, optional absence/null/falsy values preserved. Returned @odata.nextLink and @odata.deltaLink are opaque output only; no follow-link input or automatic pagination. Delete Outlook Master Category: DELETE /v1.0/{me|users/userId}/outlook/masterCategories/{categoryId}. Requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation CATEGORIES_DELETE. Reconcile uncertain outcomes before repeating. One fixed-origin Graph HTTPS request, zero retries and redirect:error. Optional userId defaults to me; application tokens require an explicit userId. RuntimeConnection.config plus credentials.accessToken via config.$connection; tokenSecret selects an external secret. External OAuth issuance/refresh/consent and least privilege scopes required. No OAuth acquisition or renewal. Total 10 s default/30 s maximum deadline starts before profile/secret lookup, bounded 100 ms cleanup; 512 KiB request/1 MiB response/256 KiB attachment bytes, pages 1–100. Exact dot and percent identities are rejected before credentials; all other route fragments are percent encoded. Strict UTF-16 input and fatal UTF-8 response JSON. Known fields projected, optional absence/null/falsy values preserved. Returned @odata.nextLink and @odata.deltaLink are opaque output only; no follow-link input or automatic pagination. ImmutableId preference enabled. No MIME, large upload session, nested item attachment expansion, webhook listener, delta continuation replay, or national-cloud endpoint. Event mutations can notify attendees and message sends are not delivery confirmation. List Outlook Calendars: GET /v1.0/{me|users/userId}/calendars. One fixed-origin Graph HTTPS request, zero retries and redirect:error. Optional userId defaults to me; application tokens require an explicit userId. RuntimeConnection.config plus credentials.accessToken via config.$connection; tokenSecret selects an external secret. External OAuth issuance/refresh/consent and least privilege scopes required. No OAuth acquisition or renewal. Total 10 s default/30 s maximum deadline starts before profile/secret lookup, bounded 100 ms cleanup; 512 KiB request/1 MiB response/256 KiB attachment bytes, pages 1–100. Exact dot and percent identities are rejected before credentials; all other route fragments are percent encoded. Strict UTF-16 input and fatal UTF-8 response JSON. Known fields projected, optional absence/null/falsy values preserved. Returned @odata.nextLink and @odata.deltaLink are opaque output only; no follow-link input or automatic pagination. ImmutableId preference enabled. No MIME, large upload session, nested item attachment expansion, webhook listener, delta continuation replay, or national-cloud endpoint. Event mutations can notify attendees and message sends are not delivery confirmation. definitions.name: List Outlook Calendar Events (Direct)
definitions.description: List Outlook Calendar Events
definitions.documentation:
List Outlook Calendar Events: GET /v1.0/{me|users/userId}/calendars/{calendarId}/events. One fixed-origin Graph HTTPS request, zero retries and redirect:error. Optional userId defaults to me; application tokens require an explicit userId. RuntimeConnection.config plus credentials.accessToken via config.$connection; tokenSecret selects an external secret. External OAuth issuance/refresh/consent and least privilege scopes required. No OAuth acquisition or renewal. Total 10 s default/30 s maximum deadline starts before profile/secret lookup, bounded 100 ms cleanup; 512 KiB request/1 MiB response/256 KiB attachment bytes, pages 1–100. Exact dot and percent identities are rejected before credentials; all other route fragments are percent encoded. Strict UTF-16 input and fatal UTF-8 response JSON. Known fields projected, optional absence/null/falsy values preserved. Returned @odata.nextLink and @odata.deltaLink are opaque output only; no follow-link input or automatic pagination. ImmutableId preference enabled. No MIME, large upload session, nested item attachment expansion, webhook listener, delta continuation replay, or national-cloud endpoint. Event mutations can notify attendees and message sends are not delivery confirmation. definitions.documentation:
List Outlook Calendar View: GET /v1.0/{me|users/userId}/calendars/{calendarId}/calendarView. One fixed-origin Graph HTTPS request, zero retries and redirect:error. Optional userId defaults to me; application tokens require an explicit userId. RuntimeConnection.config plus credentials.accessToken via config.$connection; tokenSecret selects an external secret. External OAuth issuance/refresh/consent and least privilege scopes required. No OAuth acquisition or renewal. Total 10 s default/30 s maximum deadline starts before profile/secret lookup, bounded 100 ms cleanup; 512 KiB request/1 MiB response/256 KiB attachment bytes, pages 1–100. Exact dot and percent identities are rejected before credentials; all other route fragments are percent encoded. Strict UTF-16 input and fatal UTF-8 response JSON. Known fields projected, optional absence/null/falsy values preserved. Returned @odata.nextLink and @odata.deltaLink are opaque output only; no follow-link input or automatic pagination. ImmutableId preference enabled. No MIME, large upload session, nested item attachment expansion, webhook listener, delta continuation replay, or national-cloud endpoint. Event mutations can notify attendees and message sends are not delivery confirmation. definitions.documentation:
List Outlook Event Instances: GET /v1.0/{me|users/userId}/events/{eventId}/instances. One fixed-origin Graph HTTPS request, zero retries and redirect:error. Optional userId defaults to me; application tokens require an explicit userId. RuntimeConnection.config plus credentials.accessToken via config.$connection; tokenSecret selects an external secret. External OAuth issuance/refresh/consent and least privilege scopes required. No OAuth acquisition or renewal. Total 10 s default/30 s maximum deadline starts before profile/secret lookup, bounded 100 ms cleanup; 512 KiB request/1 MiB response/256 KiB attachment bytes, pages 1–100. Exact dot and percent identities are rejected before credentials; all other route fragments are percent encoded. Strict UTF-16 input and fatal UTF-8 response JSON. Known fields projected, optional absence/null/falsy values preserved. Returned @odata.nextLink and @odata.deltaLink are opaque output only; no follow-link input or automatic pagination. ImmutableId preference enabled. No MIME, large upload session, nested item attachment expansion, webhook listener, delta continuation replay, or national-cloud endpoint. Event mutations can notify attendees and message sends are not delivery confirmation. definitions.description: Get Outlook Event
definitions.documentation:
Get Outlook Event: GET /v1.0/{me|users/userId}/events/{eventId}. One fixed-origin Graph HTTPS request, zero retries and redirect:error. Optional userId defaults to me; application tokens require an explicit userId. RuntimeConnection.config plus credentials.accessToken via config.$connection; tokenSecret selects an external secret. External OAuth issuance/refresh/consent and least privilege scopes required. No OAuth acquisition or renewal. Total 10 s default/30 s maximum deadline starts before profile/secret lookup, bounded 100 ms cleanup; 512 KiB request/1 MiB response/256 KiB attachment bytes, pages 1–100. Exact dot and percent identities are rejected before credentials; all other route fragments are percent encoded. Strict UTF-16 input and fatal UTF-8 response JSON. Known fields projected, optional absence/null/falsy values preserved. Returned @odata.nextLink and @odata.deltaLink are opaque output only; no follow-link input or automatic pagination. ImmutableId preference enabled. No MIME, large upload session, nested item attachment expansion, webhook listener, delta continuation replay, or national-cloud endpoint. Event mutations can notify attendees and message sends are not delivery confirmation. definitions.documentation:
Create Outlook Calendar Event: POST /v1.0/{me|users/userId}/calendars/{calendarId}/events. Requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation EVENTS_CREATE. Reconcile uncertain outcomes before repeating. One fixed-origin Graph HTTPS request, zero retries and redirect:error. Optional userId defaults to me; application tokens require an explicit userId. RuntimeConnection.config plus credentials.accessToken via config.$connection; tokenSecret selects an external secret. External OAuth issuance/refresh/consent and least privilege scopes required. No OAuth acquisition or renewal. Total 10 s default/30 s maximum deadline starts before profile/secret lookup, bounded 100 ms cleanup; 512 KiB request/1 MiB response/256 KiB attachment bytes, pages 1–100. Exact dot and percent identities are rejected before credentials; all other route fragments are percent encoded. Strict UTF-16 input and fatal UTF-8 response JSON. Known fields projected, optional absence/null/falsy values preserved. Returned @odata.nextLink and @odata.deltaLink are opaque output only; no follow-link input or automatic pagination. ImmutableId preference enabled. No MIME, large upload session, nested item attachment expansion, webhook listener, delta continuation replay, or national-cloud endpoint. Event mutations can notify attendees and message sends are not delivery confirmation. definitions.documentation:
Update Outlook Calendar Event: PATCH /v1.0/{me|users/userId}/events/{eventId}. Requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation EVENTS_UPDATE. Reconcile uncertain outcomes before repeating. One fixed-origin Graph HTTPS request, zero retries and redirect:error. Optional userId defaults to me; application tokens require an explicit userId. RuntimeConnection.config plus credentials.accessToken via config.$connection; tokenSecret selects an external secret. External OAuth issuance/refresh/consent and least privilege scopes required. No OAuth acquisition or renewal. Total 10 s default/30 s maximum deadline starts before profile/secret lookup, bounded 100 ms cleanup; 512 KiB request/1 MiB response/256 KiB attachment bytes, pages 1–100. Exact dot and percent identities are rejected before credentials; all other route fragments are percent encoded. Strict UTF-16 input and fatal UTF-8 response JSON. Known fields projected, optional absence/null/falsy values preserved. Returned @odata.nextLink and @odata.deltaLink are opaque output only; no follow-link input or automatic pagination. ImmutableId preference enabled. No MIME, large upload session, nested item attachment expansion, webhook listener, delta continuation replay, or national-cloud endpoint. Event mutations can notify attendees and message sends are not delivery confirmation. definitions.documentation:
Delete Outlook Calendar Event: DELETE /v1.0/{me|users/userId}/events/{eventId}. Requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation EVENTS_DELETE. Reconcile uncertain outcomes before repeating. One fixed-origin Graph HTTPS request, zero retries and redirect:error. Optional userId defaults to me; application tokens require an explicit userId. RuntimeConnection.config plus credentials.accessToken via config.$connection; tokenSecret selects an external secret. External OAuth issuance/refresh/consent and least privilege scopes required. No OAuth acquisition or renewal. Total 10 s default/30 s maximum deadline starts before profile/secret lookup, bounded 100 ms cleanup; 512 KiB request/1 MiB response/256 KiB attachment bytes, pages 1–100. Exact dot and percent identities are rejected before credentials; all other route fragments are percent encoded. Strict UTF-16 input and fatal UTF-8 response JSON. Known fields projected, optional absence/null/falsy values preserved. Returned @odata.nextLink and @odata.deltaLink are opaque output only; no follow-link input or automatic pagination. ImmutableId preference enabled. No MIME, large upload session, nested item attachment expansion, webhook listener, delta continuation replay, or national-cloud endpoint. Event mutations can notify attendees and message sends are not delivery confirmation. definitions.name: Outlook Event accept (Direct)
definitions.description: Outlook Event accept
definitions.documentation:
Outlook Event accept: POST /v1.0/{me|users/userId}/events/{eventId}/accept. Requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation EVENTS_ACCEPT. Reconcile uncertain outcomes before repeating. One fixed-origin Graph HTTPS request, zero retries and redirect:error. Optional userId defaults to me; application tokens require an explicit userId. RuntimeConnection.config plus credentials.accessToken via config.$connection; tokenSecret selects an external secret. External OAuth issuance/refresh/consent and least privilege scopes required. No OAuth acquisition or renewal. Total 10 s default/30 s maximum deadline starts before profile/secret lookup, bounded 100 ms cleanup; 512 KiB request/1 MiB response/256 KiB attachment bytes, pages 1–100. Exact dot and percent identities are rejected before credentials; all other route fragments are percent encoded. Strict UTF-16 input and fatal UTF-8 response JSON. Known fields projected, optional absence/null/falsy values preserved. Returned @odata.nextLink and @odata.deltaLink are opaque output only; no follow-link input or automatic pagination. ImmutableId preference enabled. No MIME, large upload session, nested item attachment expansion, webhook listener, delta continuation replay, or national-cloud endpoint. Event mutations can notify attendees and message sends are not delivery confirmation. definitions.description: Outlook Event tentativelyAccept
definitions.documentation:
Outlook Event tentativelyAccept: POST /v1.0/{me|users/userId}/events/{eventId}/tentativelyAccept. Requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation EVENTS_TENTATIVELY_ACCEPT. Reconcile uncertain outcomes before repeating. One fixed-origin Graph HTTPS request, zero retries and redirect:error. Optional userId defaults to me; application tokens require an explicit userId. RuntimeConnection.config plus credentials.accessToken via config.$connection; tokenSecret selects an external secret. External OAuth issuance/refresh/consent and least privilege scopes required. No OAuth acquisition or renewal. Total 10 s default/30 s maximum deadline starts before profile/secret lookup, bounded 100 ms cleanup; 512 KiB request/1 MiB response/256 KiB attachment bytes, pages 1–100. Exact dot and percent identities are rejected before credentials; all other route fragments are percent encoded. Strict UTF-16 input and fatal UTF-8 response JSON. Known fields projected, optional absence/null/falsy values preserved. Returned @odata.nextLink and @odata.deltaLink are opaque output only; no follow-link input or automatic pagination. ImmutableId preference enabled. No MIME, large upload session, nested item attachment expansion, webhook listener, delta continuation replay, or national-cloud endpoint. Event mutations can notify attendees and message sends are not delivery confirmation. definitions.description: Outlook Event decline
definitions.documentation:
Outlook Event decline: POST /v1.0/{me|users/userId}/events/{eventId}/decline. Requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation EVENTS_DECLINE. Reconcile uncertain outcomes before repeating. One fixed-origin Graph HTTPS request, zero retries and redirect:error. Optional userId defaults to me; application tokens require an explicit userId. RuntimeConnection.config plus credentials.accessToken via config.$connection; tokenSecret selects an external secret. External OAuth issuance/refresh/consent and least privilege scopes required. No OAuth acquisition or renewal. Total 10 s default/30 s maximum deadline starts before profile/secret lookup, bounded 100 ms cleanup; 512 KiB request/1 MiB response/256 KiB attachment bytes, pages 1–100. Exact dot and percent identities are rejected before credentials; all other route fragments are percent encoded. Strict UTF-16 input and fatal UTF-8 response JSON. Known fields projected, optional absence/null/falsy values preserved. Returned @odata.nextLink and @odata.deltaLink are opaque output only; no follow-link input or automatic pagination. ImmutableId preference enabled. No MIME, large upload session, nested item attachment expansion, webhook listener, delta continuation replay, or national-cloud endpoint. Event mutations can notify attendees and message sends are not delivery confirmation. definitions.description: Cancel Outlook Event
definitions.documentation:
Cancel Outlook Event: POST /v1.0/{me|users/userId}/events/{eventId}/cancel. Requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation EVENTS_CANCEL. Reconcile uncertain outcomes before repeating. One fixed-origin Graph HTTPS request, zero retries and redirect:error. Optional userId defaults to me; application tokens require an explicit userId. RuntimeConnection.config plus credentials.accessToken via config.$connection; tokenSecret selects an external secret. External OAuth issuance/refresh/consent and least privilege scopes required. No OAuth acquisition or renewal. Total 10 s default/30 s maximum deadline starts before profile/secret lookup, bounded 100 ms cleanup; 512 KiB request/1 MiB response/256 KiB attachment bytes, pages 1–100. Exact dot and percent identities are rejected before credentials; all other route fragments are percent encoded. Strict UTF-16 input and fatal UTF-8 response JSON. Known fields projected, optional absence/null/falsy values preserved. Returned @odata.nextLink and @odata.deltaLink are opaque output only; no follow-link input or automatic pagination. ImmutableId preference enabled. No MIME, large upload session, nested item attachment expansion, webhook listener, delta continuation replay, or national-cloud endpoint. Event mutations can notify attendees and message sends are not delivery confirmation. Optional userId defaults to me; application tokens require an explicit userId. RuntimeConnection.config plus credentials.accessToken via config.$connection; tokenSecret selects an external secret. External OAuth issuance/refresh/consent and least privilege scopes required. No OAuth acquisition or renewal. Total 10 s default/30 s maximum deadline starts before profile/secret lookup, bounded 100 ms cleanup; 512 KiB request/1 MiB response/256 KiB attachment bytes, pages 1–100. Exact dot and percent identities are rejected before credentials; all other route fragments are percent encoded. Strict UTF-16 input and fatal UTF-8 response JSON. Known fields projected, optional absence/null/falsy values preserved. Returned @odata.nextLink and @odata.deltaLink are opaque output only; no follow-link input or automatic pagination. ingressRequirements.name: Microsoft Outlook verified event relay
ingressRequirements.description: Graph mail/calendar basic notification relay. Accepts the canonical onf.business.v1 envelope only; an external provider-aware relay is required.
setupSteps: Install this reviewed package release; no relay or subscription is installed.
Deploy an independently maintained provider-aware relay which implements the exact provider signature, challenge, authorization and replay rules described below.
Implement Graph POST ?validationToken=… verification at the relay: return the URL-decoded token as text/plain with HTTP 200 within ten seconds; this is not ONF GET challenge support.

For basic notifications, compare clientState in constant time with the saved subscription secret and allowlist tenantId, subscriptionId and subscribed resource. Reject rich notifications (validationTokens/encryptedContent); this contract uses includeResourceData=false only.

Create the least-privileged subscription manually, maintain its expiration and lifecycle notifications, and keep the OAuth grant current. Split value[] into separate canonical events; redact clientState.

Use notification id when supplied, or persist a stable relay identity per admitted notification across its ONF retries. The relay may assign different IDs to separate duplicate provider deliveries; exact provider deduplication is not promised.
Subscribe only to authorized message or event resources. Map resource and changeType to message.created/updated/deleted or event.created/updated/deleted; scopeId is subscriptionId.

Emit canonical JSON {contract:"onf.business.v1",provider:"microsoft-outlook",eventType,eventId,scopeId,resourceId,occurredAt,resource}; occurredAt and nullable resource fields must explicitly be null when unavailable. The resource fields and eventType are defined by the selected trigger schema. Preserve eventId across relay retries.
Save a separate relay-to-ONF callback secret; create a header-authenticated ingress profile for this requirement.
Bind the intended trigger node, configure the relay with its HTTPS callback URL, then deliberately enable workflow and entry.
Review relay limits, delivery identifiers, retries and downstream idempotency; test explicitly before production use.

Select saved node entry mode webhook explicitly; package metadata does not infer it. Create/select a profile for this exact installed requirement (installation.id + "/verified-provider-relay"), bind node.trigger.ingress.profileId, save the graph and deliberately enable workflow and entry only when setup is complete.
